hero.name: Hand Block Printing Virtual Museum
hero.tagline: Walk a real-time 3D museum of India's hand block printing in the browser, from the Grand Atrium to the Dye Garden, curated live from one admin.
hero.label: Hand Block Printing Virtual Museum: walk a real-time 3D museum of hand block printing in the browser, curated live from one admin

cards.label: What the museum does: walk, light, examine, print, tour live and curate

items.title: Thirteen rooms, one building
items.body: Atrium, reception, passage, reveal wall, Galleries A to D, theatre, workshop, dye garden, shop, library.

items.title: Daylight to night
items.body: Five times of day, 3000 K track light, a path-traced photo mode and four quality tiers that adapt to the device.

items.title: Down to the thread
items.body: Deep-zoom textiles with a centimetre scale bar, and scanned hand blocks to turn in 3D or place in your room in AR.

items.title: Print it yourself
items.body: Stamp blocks, dyes and borders in the studio, then hang the cloth on the Visitors' Wall after review.

items.title: Docent-led tours
items.body: Visitors see each other, follow a signed docent tour, chat and raise a hand, or walk the museum in VR.

items.title: An admin for curators
items.body: Exhibitions, makers, media, tour editor, history with restore, trash, activity log and conflict-safe saves.
